intro: Six years in content production, from full-time web3 producer to freelancer and agency producer. In web3 since 2020. At ETHGlobal I led all video production for a year and four months: 600+ videos edited and 25+ in-person and online events produced.

groups.title: Event recaps
groups.text: Producing recap films at hackathons and conferences around the world, finding and directing local crews in each city.

groups.title: Interviews & panels
groups.text: Live interviews, panels and fireside chats, produced with local production companies hired and directed in each city.

groups.title: Social content
groups.text: Social campaigns for CoinDesk's Consensus conferences: Hong Kong 2025 and 2026, Toronto and Miami.

groups.title: Social clips
groups.text: Short-form interview clips cut for social.

groups.title: Launches & teasers
groups.text: Announcement and teaser films for hackathon programs.

groups.title: Series & branding
groups.text: Strategized, organized and produced 16 weeks of PayPal USD Stable Club webinars across social channels with Google, Stellar, LayerZero and QuickNode. Led the rebrand of ETHGlobal's video identity: custom frames for online and live events, lower thirds and social branding.
